newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Rubber futures close lower across the board on Wednesday in moderate trade on some late selling interest in line with weaker Japanese prices, brokers said.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were marked down across the board under pressure by the yen's firmness against the dollar. But trade was lacklustre due to a lack of fresh incentives.
Prices were mostly steady in the morning on some light trade as some people bought a small amount of RSS3 rubber.
"We did a bit of RSS3 rubber and then tried to sell some more rubber this morning, but there were simply no takers," a local rubber trader said.
"But prices were marked down sharply in the afternoon on some late local selling interest in sympathy with lower prices in Tokyo and Kobe. Volume was moderate," he said.
At around 0945 GMT, February RSS3 fell 0.25 cent to 125.50 U.S. cents a kg. February RSS1 fell half a cent to 178.50 Singapore cents (US$1.27) a kg.
February TSR20 fell half a cent to 173.25 Singapore cents (US$1.23) a kg.
